# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- Observe that this reflection alters the sign of only one pion field, so their convention for the relative phase differs by an added π compared with refs. [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is constructed by reversing the sign of all three pion fields.  
- The convention adopted in this work allows for a more natural comparison with the analogous configuration in the monopole case.

# 3.10
- The profile function vanishes at a radius of s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) centre, ensuring that the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion are smoothly joined, with the fields taking vacuum values outside each core.  
- Besides the initial conditions derived from the simple ansatz (3.7), more refined initial data were employed using the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric map of charge n.
